One thing I saw a lot of growing up
are
marshmallows
paired
with
chocolate.
Choco
Mallows
and
Wiggles
are
the
two
biggest
ones
I
grew up with. Something about soft
and
fluffy
mixed
with
rich
and
chocolate-y
seems
to
be
something
we Filipinos really love. I’m hoping

trying them out gives you a sense

of why we Filipinos love them

so much.
